There's an island where the members of one society meet, away from everyone else. Only a handful of outsiders have ever been let onto it.

The people invited inside aren't random - a former president, a former secretary of state, Supreme Court judges, all tied to the same society they joined decades earlier at the same university.

A few miles away, a different grove held the same kind of gathering - presidents from opposing parties and a former Soviet leader, in the same room.

It was never two sides. It was one circle, wearing two faces for the cameras.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to spot that circle operating today.

clips.caption:
There's a class of people the people at the top have a name for: the followers. Not slaves - just a decent apartment, running water, a few nice things, and a job you show up to.

The quiet part is what makes it work - keep them comfortable enough to never revolt, and in debt enough to never leave. Work. Buy stuff. Have a couple of kids. Go further into debt. Then die.

No poverty, no visible chains - which is why almost no one sees the cage.

You weren't born into this life by accident. You were sorted into it, and the sorting was built so you'd never notice.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to tell which class you were actually built to stay in.
